observations: Current N3-N5 main1390/1440, ritual153/160, command122/160, defaults46/160.
Main ranged actors have240attack at distance1 and360at distances3-4; legacyPower uses distance1.
V3 skills are absent from legacy skill rating, and positive dodge has no legacy assessment benefit because max(1,1-dodgeProbability) equals1.
MAIN is a mixed formation; COMMAND_CUIRASS and FULL_DEFAULTS are homogeneous front formations. Differences do not isolate one item or one parameter.
All three main profiles have the same numerical legacy assessment and NPC stats for a given size. Their different seeds prevent interpreting win differences as a pure skill effect.
Before range correction, main N3-N5 already won1381/1440; the near-certain region was not created by the range correction.
Before range correction, defaults N3-N5 won98/160; after correction46/160. A global strength increase risks worsening existing weak/default and command-vs-storm cases.
recommendation: Use only a prespecified bounded exploratory test of one common coefficient after fixing the intended availability policy. Report free/command counter-matchups separately; do not hide them in MAIN averages or declare that one coefficient is impossible without new tests.
